title: Official Metadata Addon Mature Provider Model Research
problem: The metadata scraper provider architecture is now extensible, but the next fearless refactor should be informed by mature metadata provider systems instead of local intuition alone.

evidence.summary: Research lane opened, repo-ref ignored, and selected mature metadata reference repositories cloned for read-only study.
Current nako-metadata-scraper architecture compared against mature provider findings; resolver-first refactor candidates ranked.
Research lane closed with no production code changes; resolver and external ID capability implementation was split to a follow-on lane that is now complete.

Status refresh recorded that resolver, external ID capabilities, and provider field-policy fusion are completed baseline architecture; remaining follow-ons are host policy context, artwork source separation, matching strategy refinement, and only-if-needed cache/throttle execution state.

continue_policy.notes: Research is complete. The original provider fact resolver and external ID capability follow-on has been completed, and provider field-policy fusion is baseline architecture. Remaining follow-ons are host policy context, artwork source separation, matching strategy refinement, and only-if-needed cache/throttle execution state; host-owned refresh, local metadata, locked fields, and final merge policy stay out of this sidecar lane.
